description: This file defines an InboundEmailController class that extends SugarController, responsible for handling inbound email-related actions such as editing email settings and setting defaults within the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods for rendering views, managing permissions, and redirecting users.

classes.name: InboundEmailController
classes.description: Controller class for managing inbound email interactions, extending the core SugarController, providing actions for editing inbound email settings and setting default email accounts.

methods.name: action_EditView
methods.description: Handles the display and access control for editing inbound email settings, setting view mode, and initializing email import settings based on request parameters.

methods.name: action_SetDefault
methods.description: Sets a specific inbound email account as the default for the current user, checking permissions and performing a redirect to the appropriate view.
